title: Review with confidence in noctune — iPhone
tagline: Check the draft against the recording.

headline: Hear the
moment again.
scenes.narration: This video covers reviewing a draft on iPhone: checking it against the recording, correcting it, and finishing your review. Open the encounter and switch to Transcript. Tap a passage to play the audio from that moment.

headline: Correct what
you heard.
scenes.narration: Here, the note says Mochi's weight was stable, but the transcript says it's up a little since Tuesday. Tap Edit and fix the wording. The keyboard bar adds bold, italics, headings, and lists. Use Preview to check the result, then tap Save.

headline: Complete when
you're done.
scenes.narration: Saving doesn't complete the encounter. When your review is finished, tap the arrow beside Send and Complete, then choose Mark as complete. Full screen reading is available on the web.
